Proof in the paper: The XRD patterns of the reduced Ni/SiO2 and NiIn(x:y)/SiO2 (Fig. 3) show the presence of metallic Ni in Ni/SiO2, Ni2In IMC in NiIn(2:1)/SiO2 and NiIn(1:1)/SiO2, NiIn IMC in NiIn(1:1.3)/SiO2, and Ni2In3 IMC in NiIn(1:1.6)/SiO2 and NiIn(1:2)/SiO2, as confirmed by the corresponding diffraction peaks. The TEM technique (Fig. 4) further confirms the formation of these phases and their respective crystal structures.
